digest.component_or_area: Structured output baseline eval harness in CI
propositions: Sentinel directive changes model output distributions: Anthropic and Bedrock shift from fenced/multi-object layout to 100% prose; parse success increases on all three provider arms

Baseline measurement harness parameterized by provider/model cells from TOML config runs n=10 fixed prompts (agentic transcript and single-shot contract) under current vs sentinel directive variants, captures raw replies as CI artifacts, and scores layout class rates and parser success deterministically
Per-provider API keys scoped in CI workflow are accessible only within matrix arms; missing credentials for a cell record it as unmeasured and skip it without failing the job
Call budget cap (default 300 calls/run, enforced before any network call) is predeclared as workflow input and refuses to start if matrix exceeds the limit

Unit tests validate scorer golden counts on committed E2 fixtures, credential-absent skip path, and call-budget enforcement; live workflow_dispatch run is operator-triggered and gates only on deterministic artifact evidence, not model nondeterminism
